lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, with centroids forming clear horizontal rows that maintain consistent vertical spacing across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating distinctive grid-like anchor nodes that are most prominent in the region posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with specular highlights on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of irregularly sized high-luminance blobs within the dorsal fin silhouette, though the spatial arrangement is distorted by surface-level light refraction.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several commensal fish (remoras) attached to the ventral region and trailing the posterior flank.
